text:
maria: Quick async pulse on Q3 OKR milestone — can teams confirm what shipped, what slipped, and any owner changes? Trying to close the milestone doc by EOD Friday.

sam: Shipped: inference-routing v1 (canary), model-catalog UI tweaks, embeddings-batch job landed. :shipit:

sam: Slipped: runtime-v2 autoscaler — blocked by infra quota + a perf regression in liveness checks. ETA end of next week if infra quota is approved.

maria: Thanks. Who's owning the autoscaler follow-up if infra quota doesn't come through? Need a fallback owner for the rollout plan.

sam: @tj can own the fallback; I can hand off PRs and the rollout checklist.

tj: I can take backup ownership. Action: I'll triage the perf regression tomorrow morning and post remediation steps.

tj: If we can't get quota, plan B is to reduce max pods and enable short-burst mode. That reduces throughput ~15% but keeps latency SLO.

alexa: Re: owner changes — moving the canary rollout monitoring to me for the next 72h. I'll own alerts and incident routing.

chris: Heads-up: three CRs are waiting on reviews for model-catalog UI (PR#412, PR#419, PR#421). If reviewers can ping, we should finish today.

maria: Chris, can you drop a quick checklist in the milestone doc for the PRs and test coverage gaps? I'll nudge Design for accessibility checks.

chris: Done — added checklist line items and assigned @sam and @alexa for fixes.

sam: Quick links: PR#412 https://git.redwood/rc/pr/412, PR#419 https://git.redwood/rc/pr/419. Test repro snippet below that shows flakiness locally:
```
pytest tests/ui/test_catalog.py::TestCatalog::test_model_search -k flaky
```

alexa: I'll take PR#419 review after the morning stand.

tj: For the autoscaler perf regression: attaching the failing trace in the doc, but short term patch is one-liner in `runtime/health.go` to skip heavy probes during scale-up. I'll open a PR if triage confirms.

deploy-bot: deploy started for inference-routing v1 canary — build bld-2026.03.20-87 -> staging (1764342285) :rocket:

maria: Noted. For milestone doc status: done = inference-routing, model-catalog tweaks, embeddings-batch. At-risk = runtime-v2 autoscaler. Blocked = infra quota. Next steps: tj to triage perf, alexa to monitor canary, sam to finish handoff PRs, chris to get reviews.

maria: Also, please add any cross-team deps (security review, infra quota owner) so I can escalate.

sam: Infra quota owner is @devops-infra team (cc: @eli). I've pinged them separately.

tj: I'll post triage notes and link PR by 09:30 tomorrow. If no quota by Wed EOD, we'll enact plan B and update milestone doc.

alexa: I'm on rotation to handle alerts tonight; ping me in #eng-oncall if anything spikes.

maria: Great — this is enough to update the milestone doc. I'll mark owner shifts and push a summary to execs tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone. :pray:
